{{Quote|This is Captain Wo Kasto, Manaan Special Warfare Group.|[[Minn Ishkah]]|<ref name="Uncertain Cooperation" />}}
'''Wo Kasto''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Manaan Special Warfare Group]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|On his watch, the food shipments I've arranged have been "misplaced," meetings are delayed after the Republic representatives were kept waiting.... Kasto may be inflexible and uptight, but he is smart--and very capable. These "disruptions" are happening for a reason. He wants to test our resolve, but he also wants to be able to deny that he is provoking us.|[[Minn Ishkah]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="Uncertain Cooperation" />}}
Captain Kasto was handpicked to join the [[Manaan Special Warfare Group]] by its founder, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Wen Gallo]]. Kasto was the product of a long line of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and researchers, while the majority of [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] who enlisted came from highly-respected military legacies.

Against everyone's predictions, Kasto quickly proved himself. He attained the rank of Captain in record time, thanks to his inquiring mind, no-nonsense disposition, and refusal to accept failure-all of which he attributed to being raised in a science-rich environment.<ref name="CX">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Wo Kasto}}</ref>

After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] helped the Manaan Special Warfare Group repel an [[Invasion of Manaan|invasion]] by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], Captain Kasto was elected to represent the organization in negotiating an alliance with the Republic.<ref name="Uncertain Cooperation" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Thank you—again. You helped, and my own people couldn't… I'm starting to think there's a reason for that.|Wo Kasto, if he is recruited by an Imperial player|<ref name="ACP">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Empire|A Conservative Proposal|[[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]}}</ref>}}
Wo Kasto appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|Legacy of the Sith]]'' expansion of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the contacts for the Republic bonus series on Manaan.<ref name="Uncertain Cooperation" />

After completing the final mission, "Retribution in the Rift", the player can receive mail from Wo Kasto expressing his disapproval over a budding relationship forming between [[Minn Ishkah]] and his sister, the former Manaan isolationist, [[Mata (biologist)|Mata]].<ref name="Mail">{{TORcite|type=message|Help me with this, please!|Captain Wo Kasto}}</ref>

In the Imperial storyline of the Manaan bonus series, Wo Kasto serves as a boss encounter during the mission, "Veiled Threats", after which the player has the option to kill him or let him go.<ref name="Veiled Threats">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Empire|Veiled Threats|[[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]}}</ref> If the player chooses to spare him, he will appear again in the [[Temple of the Progenitor]] during the final mission, "A Conservative Proposal", having been captured by [[The Conservator]]. If asked, he reveals that his superior was not pleased with him upon learning that he failed to defeat the player, and so she decided to send him to eliminate the Conservator. Wo Kasto chose instead to attempt negotiating, which resulted in failure and his capture. The player then has the option to attack him, leave him imprisoned, or free him on the condition that he leaves the Manaan Special Warfare Group and fights for the Empire.<ref name="ACP" />
